parsed.reason: This message fails on almost every criterion. (1) It misidentifies Pat as "the dad" when Pat just said "grandma here!" — the role to echo back is grandparent/grandma, not dad; asserting the wrong role is a severe fault. (2) It claims Hale "booked swim and synced your calendar" — invented facts not in the request, and calendar/plans talk is explicitly prohibited. (3) It contains an emoji (😊), which is disallowed. (4) It contains a URL (www.example.com), which is explicitly prohibited. (5) It does not say Pat's name, required by mustMention. (6) It does not say back "grandparent," required by mustMention and the role_confirmed kind. (7) It ends with "see www.example.com?" which is both a URL and an implicit question when questions must be 0. Essentially every rule is broken.
